title: Passenger evacuation process simulation for a wide-body-aircraft with a lower deck seating compartment.
author: Mailema Celestino dos Santos
abstract: Work based on evacuation simulations of an Airplane with Lower Deck Seating (LDS) Compartment, in order to estimate the Evacuation time. Using the Software SERVICE MODEL, the simulations where elaborated in an A340-300 Standard Layout and in an A340-300 LDS. In case of a LDS, the analyses of an evacuation are presented through the main floor exits and through the both floors. In order to organize the simulation logic, it was developed an algorithm using the hypothesis presented in some references about psychological effects in wide-body-aircrafts and the FAR Part 25 rules. The validation method was attested, since the default data was available by the Airbus Company.
